title: Creator shortlist (team artifact)
description: Creators who fit the game's audience, with dated public sources and outreach drafts, from Streamer and Patch Notes. Only the owner contacts anyone. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).

version.description: Artifact schema version the producer wrote. Same major as x-version.

id.description: Template id, or owner for files the owner makes.

createdAt.description: UTC time the file was written.

synthetic.description: True for worked examples. Consumers never treat synthetic data as a measurement.

build.description: The build the items describe, when they describe one.

ref.description: A label the owner can resolve; never stored in team memory.

sourceDate.description: UTC date the public source was checked.

draft.description: Outreach draft for the owner to send or not.
